question: What are the most influential papers on exosome biomarkers? Return 5 with DOIs and citation counts.
final_text: {"answer":"The most influential papers regarding exosome biomarkers, based on citation counts, include comprehensive reviews on extracellular vesicle composition and isolation, proteomic profiling in human urine, and the clinical potential of exosomes in disease diagnosis and cancer metastasis.","citations":[{"doi":"10.3390/cells8070727","title":"Overview of Extracellular Vesicles, Their Origin, Composition, Purpose, and Methods for Exosome Isolation and Analysis","citation_count":2903},{"doi":"10.1073/pnas.0403453101","title":"Identification and proteomic profiling of exosomes in human urine","citation_count":1956},{"doi":"10.1186/s13578-019-0282-2","title":"Exosomes: biogenesis, biologic function and clinical potential","citation_count":1892},{"doi":"10.1016/j.ccell.2016.10.009","title":"Extracellular Vesicles in Cancer: Cell-to-Cell Mediators of Metastasis","citation_count":1780},{"doi":"10.7150/thno.18133","title":"Progress in Exosome Isolation Techniques","citation_count":1760}]}
